title: Chapter 17 Revision — Travel & Accommodation
description: Mixed revision quiz covering genitive plural, prepositions + cases, travel phrases, and accommodation language from Chapter 17.

questions.explanation: Masculine animate/inanimate nouns take -ów in genitive plural: student → studentów. 'Mam dużo studentów' = I have many students.

questions.prompt: Genitive plural of 'kobieta' (f) — Nie ma tutaj ___.
questions.explanation: Feminine nouns ending in -a take zero ending (drop -a) in genitive plural: kobieta → kobiet. 'Nie ma tutaj kobiet' = There are no women here.

questions.prompt: Genitive plural of 'okno' (n) — W pokoju nie ma ___.
questions.explanation: Neuter nouns in -o/-e take zero ending with fleeting vowel insertion: okno → okien (o inserted before final n). 'Nie ma okien' = There are no windows.

questions.prompt: Idę ___ sklepu. (I'm going to the shop.) [destination]
questions.explanation: 'Do + genitive' = to (destination): idę do sklepu. 'W + locative' = in (location). 'Na' = onto/to (surface/event).

questions.prompt: Kawa ___ mleka, proszę. (Coffee without milk, please.)
questions.explanation: 'Bez + genitive' = without: bez mleka (mleko → genitive: mleka). Contrast: 'z mlekiem' = with milk (z + instrumental).

questions.prompt: Poproszę bilet ___ Krakowa. (A ticket to Kraków, please.)
questions.explanation: Ticket destination: bilet do + genitive. 'Bilet do Krakowa' = ticket to Kraków (Kraków → genitive: Krakowa).

questions.prompt: Wróciłam ___ Paryża wczoraj. (I returned from Paris yesterday.) [wrócić z + gen]
questions.explanation: 'Wrócić z + genitive' = to return from. 'Z Paryża' (Paryż → genitive: Paryża). Contrast 'do Paryża' = to Paris (destination).

questions.prompt: Chciałbym pokój ___ łazienką. (I'd like a room with a bathroom.)
questions.explanation: 'Z + instrumental' = with: z łazienką (łazienka → instrumental: łazienką). 'Bez łazienki' = without a bathroom.

questions.prompt: Pokój jest ___ trzecim piętrze. (The room is on the third floor.)
questions.explanation: Floor location: 'na + locative'. 'Na trzecim piętrze' = on the third floor (piętro → locative: piętrze).
'Nocleg' (m) = overnight stay / accommodation. From 'noc' (night) + 'leg' (root of leżeć, to lie). E.g. 'Szukam noclegu' = I'm looking for accommodation.
'Bilet powrotny' = return ticket. From 'powrotny' (return, adj.) < 'powrót' (return, n.). Contrast: 'bilet w jedną stronę' = one-way ticket.

questions.prompt: O której należy się ___? (What time do we need to check out?)
questions.explanation: 'Wymeldować się' (perf) = to check out. 'Zameldować się' = to check in. Both come from 'meldunek' (registration). 'O której należy się wymeldować?' = What time is check-out?
